snippet.title: Blaster Master Zero Version 1.3 Update - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The next round of new content for Blaster Master Zero is here, and with it come two indie game legends who are ready to venture into the mutant-filled subterranean depths! 

Play through the entire game as new EX Characters Shantae and Shovel Knight, each featuring their own unique abilities straight from their original titles. It's an indie megamix in the world of Blaster Master Zero! Just like Gunvolt and Ekoro before them, these new characters will be available as a free download for the first two weeks after their release before turning into $1.99 paid DLC.

Shantae release on the eShop July 6, 2017!
Shovel Knight releases on the eShop August 3, 2017!

Official Website: http://blastermaster-zero.com/en/
Twitter (Blaster Master): https://twitter.com/BlasterMasterZ
Twitter (Inti Creates): https://twitter.com/IntiCreatesEN
Facebook (Inti Creates): https://www.facebook.com/inticreates/


Product Details
Title： Blaster Master Zero
Hardware： Nintendo Switch(TM) & Nintendo 3DS 
Genre： Action Adventure
Rating： E for Everyone (Mild Fantasy Violence), PEGI 7
Release Date： March 9th, 2017
Players：TV Mode: 1-2 Players, Tabletop Mode: 1-2 Players, Handheld Mode: 1 Player
Price： $9.99, €9.99, £8.99
Developer： Inti Creates
